notes.title: HOME Update!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Thanks everyone for your positive reviews and feedback. It really means a lot to us and we really appreciate all your support. We never expected the game would take off the way it did, so we're really glad it reached and touched so many people.

HOME would not be where it is without all of you. 

Our sincere gratitude, 
Lore Nine

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Frame rate is now set to [b]60[/b]
[*]Diagonal movement speed is consistent with regular speed
[*]Mouse now locks on screen
[*]Performance optimization and minor bug fixes
[/list]
[b]Content[/b]
[list]
[*]Volume control now added in settings
[*]Look Sensitivity now added in settings
[*]Localization: German, Russian
[*][i]Community-made[/i] Localization (Special thanks): Turkish, Italian
[*]Additional interactable object
[/list]
